ideas.pitch: A real-time voice-activated tactical assistant for Valorant teams that listens to match audio and displays optimal defensive or offensive setups on an overlay based on enemy economy and callouts.
ideas.title: ValorantStratCoach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the core theme of the esports tournament by directly enhancing team coordination and strategic decision-making during live matches.

ideas.pitch: An automated tournament match analyzer that ingests custom game round data and generates heatmaps, clutch success rates, and team positioning statistics for post-match debriefs.
ideas.title: BattleZoneStats
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides immediate practical value to tournament organizers and competing 5-person squads wanting competitive edges.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI bot trained to simulate standard Valorant agent utility usage and gunfight positioning to help tournament teams warm up and practice against specific compositions.
ideas.title: ValorantAgentBot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced multi-agent coordination and complex state simulation directly relevant to competitive gaming environments.

ideas.pitch: A live telemetry dashboard for tournament admins to monitor team communication stress levels, round timings, and technical stability anomalies during matches.
ideas.title: EsportsCommMonitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves real-world operational challenges for an in-person BYOD esports tournament with tight schedules.

ideas.pitch: A gamified companion app for tournament spectators to predict round outcomes and earn points while watching live matches unfold in the venue.
ideas.title: ClutchCompanion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Enhances audience engagement during downtime between tournament rounds at an in-person venue.
